checks.summary: Validate repository configuration against its closed schema
Keep configured and transported paths within their trusted root
Reject unsafe release-profile ownership and permissions
Require UTF-8 Containerfiles with Unix line endings and a final newline
Require uppercase Containerfile instruction keywords
Reject Docker BuildKit parser directives and extensions
Require named lowercase build stages and named stage references
Require fully qualified external image references
Require digest pins for every external image input
Reject remote ADD and implicit archive extraction
Reject network-to-interpreter command pipelines
Reject world-writable permissions and undeclared set-ID chmod targets
Require the final numeric user to match the reviewed runtime contract
Require JSON exec form for ENTRYPOINT and CMD
Reject Docker-format HEALTHCHECK metadata
Verify mandatory OCI image labels against observed source facts
Report Hadolint diagnostics with their upstream rule identifiers
Require systemd stop-signal metadata to match the runtime contract
Require final-stage VOLUME destinations to be declared writable runtime mounts
Require a .containerignore at the build-context root
Require context exclusions for source control, credentials and local output
Match every declared pin to exactly one Containerfile image input
Enforce bounded pin freshness and divergence observations
Report immutable-tag digest changes for supply-chain review
Bind one tag resolution to every declared pin occurrence in a non-mutating proposal
Verify a pin proposal against the current worktree before all-or-nothing application
Resolve and hold the supported release toolchain constant
Recursively verify every OCI descriptor size and digest
Match OCI descriptor platforms to image configuration
Require exact accepted platform coverage during assembly
Re-verify imported runtime content against the layout digest
Verify transported qualifications against caller-supplied digests before assembly
Test declared functional controls and separate restrictive controls
Apply and observe memory, CPU, PID and nofile limits
Test startup, health, signal forwarding, shutdown and exit status
Verify immutable runtime paths are root-owned and deny group/other writes
Validate sudo policy and test permitted, denied and restricted escalation
Run local package, vulnerability, secret and configuration scans
Reject fixable HIGH and CRITICAL findings without an exact exception
Validate exception completeness, expiry and exact finding matches
Generate and validate one digest-bound SPDX JSON SBOM per platform
Hold one validated vulnerability database snapshot across a release
Generate a unique lowercase-ULID candidate reference
Preserve and compare the complete local and remote digest graph
Enforce and verify a bounded registry candidate lifetime
Refuse immutable tag replacement and verify every promoted tag
Delete and verify removal of the candidate tag after promotion
Require default public Rekor inclusion for release signatures
Sign and verify the index and every platform manifest
Verify SBOM, provenance and release-verification attestations
Keep builder, signer and source identities distinct
Verify complete platform coverage before an authoritative rescan
Link immutable rescans and enforce remediation deadlines
Review whether the selected base image fits the application lifecycle
Review an immutable-version tag digest change as a supply-chain event
Review vulnerability exceptions through repository security ownership
Maintain release evidence retention and signing-key procedures
